svg.title: Sparse expert routing: 8 of 256 activate per token
svg.desc: Each token passes through a router that activates 8 of 256 experts; the other 248 stay idle. A 671B mixture-of-experts model with 37B active parameters moves roughly as many bytes from memory per token as a 37B dense model.
svg.text: // SPARSE EXPERT ROUTING: 8OF 256 ACTIVATE PER TOKEN
